column1: # The load check's table, read by tests/load-check/run.sh, whose header gives
# the columns: kind, name, quarters, with, warm, expect, deadline, needs,
# command, separated by tabs. README.md says why each row is here.
# expect is the median seconds of the passing runs this host recorded in
# today's lanes (the check runs from 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-10); for the four
# subjects that also run on the whole machine it is twice that median, the
# time assumed busy on two quarters, so their whole run is planned at the
# median itself. A row with no recorded run says so.
# Every scratch worktree is prepared cold by the prep rows, in order: the
# deps, then the deps compiled into each build path a check compiles in,
# one at a time, as scripts/commit-gate.sh does before its legs.

column9: env MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/test CYFR_DATABASE=sqlite MIX_ENV=test mix deps.loadpaths
env MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/test_pg CYFR_DATABASE=postgres MIX_ENV=test mix deps.loadpaths
env MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/dev_pg CYFR_DATABASE=postgres MIX_ENV=dev mix deps.loadpaths

column1: # What a subject's first run would otherwise build, warmed once in each
# worktree that runs it: the suites' test build, go's race build, and the
# release the release proofs start. The gate forces its own builds, and a
# harness self-test builds what it tests inside every run, so neither warms.

column9: env MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/test CYFR_DATABASE=sqlite MIX_ENV=test mix compile && scripts/wasm-tools.sh install _tools >/dev/null
env MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/test_pg CYFR_DATABASE=postgres MIX_ENV=test mix compile && scripts/wasm-tools.sh install _tools >/dev/null
ADAPTER=sqlite WORK=$(mktemp -d) && . tests/release-boot/release.sh && release_build; s=$?; rm -rf "$WORK"; exit $s
ADAPTER=postgres WORK=$(mktemp -d) && . tests/release-boot/release.sh && release_build; s=$?; rm -rf "$WORK"; exit $s

column1: # The busy load, on every quarter a subject leaves: a save or handoff
# row's forced compile and its PostgreSQL test run, in a loop; and on the
# last of those quarters one cold image build after another, which the
# Docker daemon runs on any processor.
# The checks that take the whole machine today, on two quarters: the suite
# on each adapter in the gate's shape, the gate and go test -race, which
# also run on the whole machine, and every harness self-test a pull-request
# workflow runs and no handoff row does. Recorded medians: suites 231 and
# 244 s, gate 987, go test -race 107, commit-gate-test 630, heavy-check-test
# Every proof, on one quarter, beside a second copy of itself, as each
# workflow step or its README runs it. The canvas proof runs at both
# viewports held to the reference host class's budget, as on this host
# today. A proof that finds no prerequisite exits 69 (77 for the proxy HSTS
# proof) and is skipped. Recorded medians per run: canvas 401 per viewport,
# approval 330 and file-offer 17 and share 25 per viewport, grant 23,
# hostile-frame 115, tincture 58, frame-facts 13, release boot 98, setup
# 15; multi-home-smoke, markdown, proxy-hsts and tailnet-real have none.

column9: set -e; for viewport in desktop 720x720; do CANVAS_PROOF_VIEWPORT="$viewport" PROOF_OUT="$LOAD_CHECK_OUT/$viewport" tests/canvas-proof/run.sh; export RELEASE_BOOT_SKIP_BUILD=1; done
set -e; for viewport in desktop 720x720; do VAULT_PROOF_VIEWPORT="$viewport" PROOF_OUT="$LOAD_CHECK_OUT/$viewport" tests/approval-proof/run.sh; export RELEASE_BOOT_SKIP_BUILD=1; done
set -e; for viewport in desktop 720x720; do VAULT_PROOF_VIEWPORT="$viewport" PROOF_OUT="$LOAD_CHECK_OUT/$viewport" tests/file-offer-proof/run.sh; export RELEASE_BOOT_SKIP_BUILD=1; done
set -e; for viewport in desktop 720x720; do VAULT_PROOF_VIEWPORT="$viewport" PROOF_OUT="$LOAD_CHECK_OUT/$viewport" tests/share-proof/run.sh; export RELEASE_BOOT_SKIP_BUILD=1; done
